title: Millie Bobby Brown Wants Tattoo of 1 Famous Star Wars Quote - NewsBreak
text:
By Evolve Editors ,
21 minutes ago Photo by Charley Gallay/Getty Images for Netflix Millie Bobby Brown is thinking about adding a new tattoo to her collection. But this time she’s inspired by a classic Star Wars moment and her husband, Jake Bongiovi.
Millie Bobby Brown reveals what Star Wars lines she wants as tattoo In an interview with Collider, Millie Bobby Brown shared that her favorite movie quote is also the one she’s considering tattooing next. The line comes from Star Wars Episode V: Empire Strikes Back, when Princess Leia says, “I love you,” and Han Solo replies, “I know.”
@colliderdotcom We can imagine Millie Bobby Brown saying this to husband Jake Bongiovi ? #StrangerThings #StrangerThings5 #ShawnLevy #MilleBobbyBrown #DufferBrothers
♬ original sound – ColliderDotCom – ColliderDotCom Millie explained that she and her husband, Jake Bongiovi, recently joked using the same exchange, which made her fall in love with the quote all over again. She said, “The other day, I said it to Jake. He was like, ‘I love you.'” and she jokingly replied, “And I was like, ‘I know.'” leading him to ask if she thought she was Han Solo. “And I was like, ‘Yeah.’ I just love that. I love that line. It’s so cute,” said Brown
This wouldn’t be the first tattoo inspired by Jake. Earlier this year, Brown revealed her “JB” tattoo on her ankle, her husband’s initials. She and Jake married in 2024 and recently revealed they adopted a baby girl.
The Stranger Things star already has several other meaningful tattoos, including two butterflies in flight on her right hip, “Ruth” on her right ribcage for her late grandmother, a rose on her left back, a tiny cowboy hat on her arm, and her famous number 11 tattoo on her left wrist in honor of her Stranger Things character, Eleven.
As of now, Brown’s tattoo collection keeps growing, and she may even add a Star Wars design soon. She’s now preparing to say her final goodbye to Eleven as the first part of the last season of Stranger Things comes out on November 26 on Netflix.
Originally reported by Ojas Kulkarni on ComingSoon.net .
